summary.zh: ETS 的學術英語測驗，常用於申請國外大學與研究所。2026 年 1 月 21 日起改為新版：題目更短、閱讀與聽力會依表現調整難度，成績改用 1–6 分制。
summary.en: ETS's academic English test, widely used for university and graduate applications abroad. Since 21 January 2026 it uses an updated format: shorter tasks, adaptive Reading and Listening, and a 1–6 score scale.

zh: TOEFL iBT 由 ETS 主辦，考閱讀、聽力、寫作、口說四項，全程用電腦作答。可以到考場考，也可以選 Home Edition 在家考，由真人監考。
2026 年 1 月 21 日起全球改用新版（之前考的仍是舊版）。新版的閱讀與聽力是「兩階段適性測驗」：先作答一組題目，系統再依表現給你較易或較難的下一組；寫作與口說則所有人題目相同。
ETS 不設及格分數，每所學校自訂要求。官方建議預留約 2 小時，實際題數與時間會隨適性測驗略有不同。
en: TOEFL iBT is run by ETS and tests Reading, Listening, Writing, and Speaking, all on a computer. You can take it at a test centre or at home with the Home Edition, monitored by a live proctor.

An updated version launched worldwide on 21 January 2026 (earlier tests used the previous version). Reading and Listening are now two-stage adaptive: after a first set of questions, you get an easier or harder second set based on your performance. Writing and Speaking are the same for everyone on a given form.
ETS sets no passing score; each institution sets its own requirement. ETS suggests allowing about two hours, and the number of items and time can vary as the test adapts.

zh: 依 ETS 官網（2026 年版）：閱讀 50 題、約 30 分鐘（Complete the Words、Read in Daily Life、Read an Academic Passage）；聽力 47 題、約 29 分鐘；寫作 12 題、約 23 分鐘；口說 11 題、約 8 分鐘（Listen and Repeat、Take an Interview）。時間不含作答說明。
聽力有四種題型：Listen and Choose a Response（聽一句話選最適合的回應）、Listen to a Conversation（多為校園生活的對話）、Listen to an Announcement（課堂或校園公告）、Listen to an Academic Talk（教授或專家的簡短學術講解）。錄音只播一次，可以做筆記，會聽到北美、英國、紐西蘭或澳洲口音。
寫作有三種題型：Build a Sentence（把字詞排成正確的句子，10 題）、Write an Email（依情境寫一封電子郵件，1 題）、Write for an Academic Discussion（在線上課堂討論中提出並支持自己的看法，1 題）。全部用鍵盤打字。
en: According to ETS (2026 format): Reading has 50 items in about 30 minutes (Complete the Words, Read in Daily Life, Read an Academic Passage); Listening 47 items in about 29 minutes; Writing 12 items in about 23 minutes; Speaking 11 items in about 8 minutes (Listen and Repeat, Take an Interview). Times exclude directions.

Listening has four task types: Listen and Choose a Response (hear one line, pick the best reply), Listen to a Conversation (mostly campus life), Listen to an Announcement (class or campus announcements), and Listen to an Academic Talk (a short talk by a professor or expert). Recordings play once, you may take notes, and you may hear North American, British, New Zealand, or Australian accents.

Writing has three task types: Build a Sentence (arrange words into a correct sentence, 10 items), Write an Email (respond to a situation, 1 item), and Write for an Academic Discussion (state and support your opinion in an online class discussion, 1 item). All answers are typed.

zh: 聽力全部是選擇題，由電腦評分，每個計分題 1 分。依 ETS 規格文件，閱讀與聽力的題數包含部分不計分的題目，用來蒐集未來出題的資料。
自 2026 年 1 月 21 日起，四個單項與總分都用 1–6 分表示，以 0.5 分為單位，並對應歐洲語言共同參考架構（CEFR）。總分是四項平均，四捨五入到最接近的 0.5 分。2026 年 1 月起的兩年過渡期內，成績單也會附上對照的 0–120 總分。
考完當下會看到非正式的閱讀與聽力成績，正式成績約在考試 3 天後公布在 ETS 帳戶。閱讀與聽力成績不能申請複查。
en: Listening is all multiple choice and machine scored, 1 point per scored item. Per ETS's specifications, the Reading and Listening item counts include some unscored items used to gather data for future tests.

Since 21 January 2026, each section and the overall score are reported on a 1–6 scale in half-point steps, aligned with the CEFR. The overall score is the average of the four sections, rounded to the nearest half band. For a two-year transition from January 2026, score reports also show a comparable 0–120 total.
You see unofficial Reading and Listening scores at the end of the test; official scores appear in your ETS account about 3 days later. Reading and Listening scores cannot be reviewed.

zh: 依 ETS 2026 年版測驗規格：Build a Sentence 每題 1 分，由電腦評分；Write an Email 與 Write for an Academic Discussion 每題最高 5 分，由 AI 評分，透過自然語言處理評估流暢度、連貫性、文法等特徵。（規格文件註明內容仍可能小幅調整。）
ETS 說明評分重點是能不能清楚、有效地傳達想法，而不是第一稿就完美無缺。寫作成績同樣以 1–6 分呈現；對寫作成績有疑問，可在考後 30 天內付費申請複查（已送分給學校後就不能申請）。
en: Per ETS's 2026 test specifications: each Build a Sentence item is worth 1 point and machine scored; Write an Email and Write for an Academic Discussion are worth up to 5 points each and AI scored, using natural language processing to assess features such as fluency, coherence, and grammar. (The document notes the specifications may still see minor revisions.)

ETS says scoring focuses on how clearly and effectively you communicate, not on a perfect first draft. Writing is also reported on the 1–6 scale; you can request a paid Writing score review within 30 days of the test, unless you have already sent scores to an institution.

zh: 新版聽力的題目短、只播一次，一個字沒聽到就可能選錯。ListenLoop 第 1 天逐句聽寫，會讓你清楚看到自己漏掉哪些字（常是冠詞、介系詞、連音）；第 2～6 天跟讀，練到聽到聲音就能對上意思；第 7 天再聽寫一次，和第 1 天比較。
口說的 Listen and Repeat 要求聽完一句後準確複述，和跟讀的練習方式很接近；建議選校園或學術內容的教材，接近考試情境。
寫作可以用 WritingLoop：第 1 天寫一封電子郵件或一段學術討論回應並取得回饋，第 2～6 天針對弱點做短練習，第 7 天不看舊稿重寫同一題，比較兩次的差異。正式考前，務必用 ETS 官方的免費模擬測驗熟悉介面與時間。
en: The new Listening tasks are short and play once, so one missed word can cost an answer. ListenLoop's Day 1 sentence-by-sentence dictation shows exactly which words you miss (often articles, prepositions, and linked sounds); Days 2–6 of shadowing train you to map sound to meaning quickly; Day 7 repeats the dictation so you can compare with Day 1.
Speaking's Listen and Repeat task asks you to repeat a sentence accurately, which is close to how shadowing works; choose campus or academic material to match the test setting.

For writing, use WritingLoop: on Day 1 write an email or an academic discussion reply and get feedback, on Days 2–6 do short exercises on your weak points, and on Day 7 rewrite the same prompt without looking at your first draft. Before test day, take ETS's free official practice test to get used to the interface and timing.

title.zh: 官方免費完整模擬測驗（2026 年新版，需填簡短表單）
title.en: Free full-length official practice test (2026 format, short form required)
